query:
WITH RECURSIVE tree AS (
            SELECT id, ''::text AS rel, 0 AS depth
              FROM folders
             WHERE id = $1
            UNION ALL
            SELECT f.id,
                   CASE WHEN t.rel = '' THEN f.name ELSE t.rel || '/' || f.name END,
                   t.depth + 1
              FROM folders f
              JOIN tree t ON f.parent_id = t.id
             WHERE f.deleted = false
               AND t.depth < $2
        )
        SELECT id AS "id!", rel AS "rel!" FROM tree
